verdict.rationale: Sardine documents ingesting transaction data from client platforms through its APIs for rule-based monitoring (sardine-docs-15). It also screens senders and receivers inline at authorization (sardine-docs-19), which implies transactions carry customer and counterparty parties. The public evidence does not show transaction schemas, identifier fields, validation errors or retry and recovery behavior, and API references are behind protected docs (sardine-docs-3). Missing for 10: documented transaction payload schema with customer/counterparty ID fields, error responses and validation semantics for rejected input, idempotency/retry guidance, hands-on corroboration.
